referee_caveats_inferred: Epoch-to-epoch CO flux comparison needs matched imaging and calibration-error treatment before attributing the reported 26% increase to variability.
The distance requires uncertain velocity geometry, ejection timing, and a 5σ Gaussian radius; the stated upper-limit direction needs checking against the supplied distance formula.
Optical-depth inputs are internally inconsistent: the prose uses LTE-fit quantities, Table 3 specifies peak brightness temperatures, and its 28SiO column differs from Table 2.
The adopted 200 K and 2100 K temperatures are described as averages of 200/300 K and 1700/2400 K; the averaging or rounding prescription is unclear.
Two H2 detections plus three upper limits give grid-dependent shock constraints; no unique shock velocity is established.
HCO+ profile recovery depends directly on the SO2 blend model; subtraction uncertainty is not quantified.
The supplied observation table has unlabeled numerical rows, preventing reliable assignment of some setup quantities.
